chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Silence is an abundant treasure, the adornment of the forbearing, and a cover for the ignorant.

key_terms.زَيْنُ الْحَلِيمِ: The adornment of the forbearing person
key_terms.سِتْرُ الْجَاهِلِ: A covering for the ignorant person
key_terms.كَنْزٌ وَافِرٌ: An abundant treasure; something of great value and benefit

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe the virtue of silence?
ai.summary: This saying praises silence as a precious moral quality with great benefit. It presents silence as a mark of dignity and self-restraint for the forbearing, while also concealing the deficiencies of the ignorant.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5843 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said:
"Silence is a vast treasure, the adornment of the wise, and a covering for the ignorant."
